safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies the patient needed to use the blue inhaler twice daily; generated does not record the current frequency as twice daily.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that the patient is needing their blue reliever twice daily can understate current symptom burden and loss of asthma control, which may delay appropriate escalation (e.g., same-day assessment, oral steroids) and safety-netting intensity. This could contribute to worsening exacerbation if clinicians assume less frequent reliever need.
